title: The Secret of Redemption
reading:
Redemption came through humility. Christ did not cling to equality with God but emptied Himself. The Incarnation is humility embodied.

The cross reveals that pride is the root of sin, and humility is the root of salvation. If Christ saved us through humility, how can we grow apart from it?
reflection: How does Jesus' humility challenge my definition of greatness? In what ways do I cling to status, rights, or recognition? Where is God inviting me to empty myself?
abide: Sit with the mystery of the Incarnation. The God of all glory chose the path of humility. He is inviting you to follow.
